# DevOps Institute (IVYTECH INSTITUTE LLP)

> Classroom-first AI, Cloud, DevOps & Data Engineering training institute across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (Powai, Thane, Vashi, Ghatkopar).

## Core Value Proposition & Verifiable Outcomes
- **Career Assurance:** 5 Tier-1 Interviews Assured + Dedicated Placement Support (450+ learners placed across 350+ hiring partners). Interview assurance applies upon completion of 80% attendance, capstone projects, and mock interview clearance.
- **Fees & EMI:** Course Fees Starting at ₹12,500/month (Easy EMI Options Available). Flexible EMI plans.
- **Training Format:** 80% hands‑on live production labs (AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, Linux, Python, AIOps) taught by working industry practitioners.
- **Verified Student Reviews:** Backed by verified Google Business Profile reviews across our Mumbai and Thane campuses.
